answer: The fee is charged through a jade debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the raven totals, and the opal anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 9 units per epoch, sustaining 316 aliases for 10 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 28 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
